'''Dalga-Wo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted at the [[Shrine of Healing]] where he directed an outsider to undertake the trials.<ref name="TOR" />
